## Highlights
### Fixed
- Extensions that open their own popup, such as 1Password when you click its button in a sign-in field while it's locked, now show it on Mac instead of doing nothing. - On Mac, a link that opens in Peek from a Chromium page now loads even when the page updates its own address as it opens the link, as web apps such as Google Drive can, instead of leaving an empty Peek or opening nothing. - On Mac, a link from another app that opens Crest now shows in front, instead of behind the window Crest reopens, and Crest's windows reopen in the order you left them.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
